title: KD GFP whole cell Replicate A
independent_unit_status: Series reports 2 biological replicates and 2 technical replicates per condition; A/B retained as biological labels; technical runs not counted as added biological units
original_characteristics: cell line: P19 embryonal carcinoma cell line
treatment_protocol: Seven different SR proteins were knocked down using costum-made esiRNAs and Lipofectamin2000. An esiRNA against GFP was used for mock transfections. Transfections were performed for 36 hours to minimize secondary effects on gene expression.
data_processing: Basecalls performed using CASAVA version 1.8.2
Remaining adaptor sequences were trimmed from reads using cutadapt -m 20 -q 25; For MISO all reads were trimmed to 75-bp length.
For Cufflinks and DEX-Seq RNA-seq reads were aligned to mm10 using Tophat v2.0.9 coupled with Bowtie v2.1.0. For MISO reads were mapped to mm9 using TopHat (v2.0.10) with the option -g1.
FPKMs were calculated using Cufflinks v2.1.1; Splicing changes were calculated with DEX-Seq and MISO.
Genome_build: Cufflinks: mm10; Ensembl v73. gtf-used for expression profiling was retrieved with ensembl-ids from uscc table browser. DEX-Seq: mm10; ENSEMBL v66. MISO: mm9

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Cufflinks: Tab-delimited text files containing gene counts of all knockdown experiments separate in cytoplasmic and whole cell samples; FPKM values of all knockdown experiments separate in cytoplasmic and whole cell samples; FPKM values of separate knockdown experiments in cytoplasmic and whole cell samples. DEX-Seq:  Text files containing read counts in exon counting bins comparing KD of SR proteins to control. MISO: Text files containing changes in expression in annotated alternative last exons (ALE) and TandemUTRs including Percent Spliced In (PSI) values and confidence intervals calculated and compared between KD samples and controls.

title: 13-SCR for SRSF 1 2 6 7 9_UN_replicate 1
independent_unit_status: Deposited triplicate sample labels; donor/culture independence and knockdown interval not established here
treatment_protocol: RAW 264.7 Macrophages seeded in a 12 well dish at 8x10^5 cells/well overnight. The next day cells were ~80% confluent. For baseline (UN) measurements, cells were collected without treatment. For infected (SAL) samples, cells were infected with Salmonella Tyhpimurium (SAL) (MOI = 10) and collected at 4h post-infection.
data_processing: 2x150 paired-end sequence reads
Illumina software used for basecalling
Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to Ensemble Grcm38 with CLC genomics Workbench
Reads Per Kilobase of exon per Megabase of library size (RPKM) were calculated using CLC Genomics Workbench
Genome_build: Grcm38
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include RPKM values for each Sample
